evidence.evidence_text: Multilingual Knowledge Graph Completion (KGC) aims to predict missing links with multilingual knowledge graphs.

To address these drawbacks, we propose a novel multilingual KGC framework with language-sensitive multi-graph attention such that the missing links on all given KGs can be inferred by a universal knowledge completion model.
Experimental results show that our model achieves significant improvements on the DBP-5L and E-PKG datasets.
